# Published competitors

The UC-GP, LVGP, and EzGP adapters use the public package implementations and
record package versions, optimization attempts, and predictive uncertainty.
They remain optional dependencies and are required only for strict publication
runs.

```{r copy-published-competitors, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
source_file <- file.path(
  repository_dir, "script", "newly-written-and-modified-scripts",
  "03_study2_published_competitors.R"
)
target_file <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "R", basename(source_file))
stopifnot(file.copy(source_file, target_file, overwrite = TRUE))
stopifnot(identical(
  unname(tools::md5sum(source_file)), unname(tools::md5sum(target_file))
))
```
